hero.label: Made for Openmart
hero.headline: I want to help Openmart turn local business signals into revenue.
hero.subheadline: Openmart is solving a real pain I felt firsthand as a BDR: finding the right local businesses to contact before your competitors do. The idea of queryable, live business intelligence layered on top of millions of SMB signals is exactly the kind of infrastructure play I want to be part of building. I am applying because I believe this product can redefine how sales teams prospect at the local level.

whyCompany.title: Local business data is massively underserved and Openmart is filling that gap
whyCompany.body: Most B2B sales tools are built for enterprise targets, leaving teams that sell into local and regional businesses with messy, outdated data. Openmart's live signal approach means reps can act on intent and context, not just static firmographic lists. That is a genuinely differentiated wedge in a crowded market.

whyCompany.title: Early Growth Lead hire means you shape the entire go-to-market motion
whyCompany.body: Joining at this stage means the playbooks, the messaging, and the channel mix do not exist yet and whoever builds them owns them. That kind of founding-team-adjacent growth role is rare and I am not interested in inheriting someone else's strategy. This is the moment where the work actually matters.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and B2B marketing background maps directly to what this role needs
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach end-to-end using HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences and helped close 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch, which means I know what it takes to build pipeline with no brand tailwind. At NextAfter I sharpened the demand generation and conversion side of B2B growth inside a data-driven consultancy. Together those two experiences give me both the top-of-funnel hustle and the analytical framing this role requires.

quote: I spent over a year manually hunting for the right businesses to cold call, knowing there had to be a smarter way. Openmart is building that smarter way, and I want to be the person who takes it to market.
